changelog: Offline downloads with a pause/resume queue, bulk album and playlist saves, tracked playlists, retained artwork and local-file playback.
Download notifications are quieter: one song saves silently, while a playlist chimes once when every song finishes; stuck progress notices are gone.
Settings now shows live saved-storage and in-progress download counts.
Now Playing Quick Actions replace Queue with Add to playlist.
Add to playlist is now a card-style sheet with real playlist covers and a keyboard-friendly New playlist field.
Listen Together shows host and friend names and avatars from YouTube Music or the local profile.
YouTube Music playlist imports now accept browse links, mixes and bare IDs as well as standard playlist links.
Pure black now works with dynamic color, and the downloaded badge and signed-in Sync section behave as before.
